featured_reviews.review_text:
Perfect South Indian Breakfast Spot
Outstanding breakfast with incredibly soft idlis that practically dissolve on your tongue—light, fluffy, and served with the best sambar and coconut chutney. The dosa variety is impressive, from classic masala and plain ghee to rava and onion varieties, all cooked to crispy perfection with generous fillings. Budget-friendly prices make it a go-to for authentic South Indian flavors without compromising on quality or taste. Highly recommend for a quick, satisfying morning meal!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Ordered a Benne Masala dosa and Davangere Pudi dosa and it was a delightful experience! The benne dosa arrived perfectly crisp, with a golden-brown hue that promised a good crunch.
True to its name, the generous use of butter (benne) gave it a rich, nutty flavor.
Accompanying the dosa was the classic coconut chutney and sambhar which was flavorful, complementing the dosa.
Also, ordered Pineapple Sheera and coffee which was good.
The service was ok, and the ambience of the hotel was simple, clean, and welcoming.
Overall, a fantastic benne dosa experience that I’d happily order again. Highly recommend for anyone craving an authentic South Indian treat!

featured_reviews.review_text: Shreejee Veg Wonders is one of the nice restaurants in the Lokhandwala locality. Pure vegetarian and good quality and quantity. featured_reviews.review_text: Its pure veg family restaurant. It has both AC and non-AC area with different menu & prices. Staff is very prompt, and service is quick. They have a juice counter with all sorts of fresh juices available. You can have a good dinner with your family here. All prices are very reasonable.

featured_reviews.name: Shivangi Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Shreejee is a pretty old restaurant located near Oshiwara police station. They've got a non AC seating on the ground floor and an ac seating on the 1st floor. Their ac seating is good and clean. This place is always crowded especially during peak lunch and dinner hours.

We ordered for

1. Paneer kadhai- a tasty creamy dish of soft succulent paneer marinated in nice tangy, not so spicy Gravy.

2. Veg Kolhapuri- a medium spicy vegetable dish made well.

3. Butter tandoori roti, butter naan- nothing much to say. Just like any other roti or naan.

4. Dal tadka- this is just an amazing dish with nice garlic flavor to it and aromatic jeera tadka. It can be eaten with either rice or chapati.

Overall a nice place to have authentic indian food with family. Pricing is also reasonable.

featured_reviews.name: Bhavezh S
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ordered online through Zomato
Paneer makhanwala gravey along with 02 butter tandoori roti
No fancy Packaging  simple brown paper bag was delivered on time by Zomato.
The paneer was really tasty with large chunks of paneer and thick gravey
Cannot say the same about the quantity it was less even for a single person
Butter roti tandoori was ok a little too soft for my likeing
Accompanied by just one small piece onion and lime, maybe these are the short coming of ordering online
Overall nice tasty
Repeated order of Paneer Makhanwala Gravey same mouth watering taste
Tried the Paneer Meal Combo consisting of 2 butter thin chappati with daal makhani ( low on quantity ) . Paneer Jeera rice and one piece cookie.
Meal combo is value for money
Once more the palak paneer was great in taste and the q
Quantity decent they take care for the small things enough onions accompanied the palak paneer with lime n green chillies.
Samosas Punjabi were too good again enough green chutney n ketchup came along
Very nice
Shreejee never seems to disappoint ordered online delivery from Zomato
Paneer Tikka Masala and Punjabi Kadhi both were tasty specially the paneer tikka masala
Keep up the taste

featured_reviews.review_text:
Sai Krishna Restaurant in Andheri offers a delightful and comprehensive vegetarian dining experience that truly deserves its high rating. It excels in delivering quality, flavour, and attentive service, making it a reliable choice for families and food enthusiasts alike.

The service here is notably prompt and courteous, contributing significantly to a smooth and enjoyable meal. The staff is attentive without being intrusive, ensuring all requests are handled quickly.

The true highlight, however, is the multi-cuisine food spread. The quality of ingredients is evident, and the kitchen successfully executes a wide variety of dishes. From the Indo-Chinese section, the Mushroom Chilly and Paneer Chilly were outstanding starters—crispy, perfectly spiced, and full of flavour. For the main course, the Mumbai classic Pav Bhaji was rich and authentic, a must-try. Finally, the combination of Dosa and Medu Wada from the South Indian selection was exceptional, with the Medu Wada being perfectly fluffy and the sambar offering just the right balance of tanginess and spice.

Sai Krishna is highly recommended for anyone in the Andheri area looking for a clean, reliable, and delicious pure-veg meal across multiple cuisines.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing to formally lodge a complaint regarding the extremely disappointing service I experienced at your establishment, Hotel Shreeji, located in Lokhandwala, Andheri West.

Recently, I had ordered food at your restaurant, and after finishing my meal, I requested the waiter to parcel the leftover food. Along with this, I asked for a small quantity of green chutney and sambhar to be included. To my surprise, I was informed that these basic accompaniments would be chargeable.

Unsatisfied with this response, I raised the concern with the owner. Unfortunately, the reply I received was highly unprofessional and disrespectful. I was told, “If you want, you have to pay; otherwise, don’t come to our restaurant.” Such behavior is completely unacceptable and reflects very poorly on the standards of hospitality expected from a reputed establishment.

As a customer, I felt insulted and deeply disappointed by the rude attitude displayed, especially by the owner. Hospitality is not just about serving food, but also about treating customers with respect and courtesy—something that was clearly lacking in this instance.

I sincerely hope you take this matter seriously and work towards improving customer service and staff behavior to avoid such incidents in the future.

featured_reviews.name: Dev Sai
featured_reviews.review_text:
JM Idly Cafe was a lifesaver during my stay in Mumbai, especially as someone missing Chennai-style food. The restaurant offers a wide range of South Indian breakfast items and serves excellent filter coffee. What sets it apart is the unique twist they add to traditional dishes, especially the dosa and idly varieties. I tried the masala dosa with vada and karapodi idly, both of which were quite delicious and satisfying.The filter coffee in the end was perfect add-on!!!!

Given that it's a South Indian restaurant in Mumbai, far from its southern roots, it exceeded all my expectations. A great place to indulge in some authentic flavors while in the city!!!!

featured_reviews.name: Chetna Mohanty
featured_reviews.review_text:
Great place for breakfast in this area. Idli was soft and the chutney had a nice flavour to it.

I was surprised by how good the filling of mysore masala dosa was! It had beetroot slices in it which gave a different taste. Loved the filter coffee too but need an extra spoon of sugar.

Overall great service and hygienic place. Highly recommended!
